title: Chapter 03 — Production Possibilities
desc: The PPC, why it bows outward, efficient vs attainable points, and what shifts the whole frontier — two live models and a chapter quiz.
intro: One picture holds scarcity, trade-offs, opportunity cost and efficiency at once — which is why it keeps coming back all quarter. The marks are in reading points off it correctly and knowing what moves the curve versus what moves you along it.
